Corporate Communications and Public Affairs Consulting
paragraphs: Our mission is to be the preeminent provider of global strategic communications by uniting a diverse group of leading government relations, corporate communications and public affairs specialists around the world for the collective success of our clients, employees, and shareholders.

Founded by veteran advisors with decades of experience in Washington, D.C.'s public policy and government relations landscape, we have grown and diversified our global communications advisory business through targeted acquisitions and organic growth. We designed our business to address the growing complexity and costs facing major corporate and non-profit entities in managing increasingly intricate and interdependent public policy and reputational challenges, and we now help more than 1,400 clients around the world navigate today's complex mosaic of stakeholders across the full spectrum of corporate affairs. Our clients include nearly half of the Fortune 100.

Across our growing portfolio, our specialized firms offer global strategic communications services, including government relations, corporate communications, public affairs, research, crisis management, financial communications and investor relations, and creative communications delivery. We are active in all major sectors of the economy, including healthcare and pharmaceuticals, asset management and financial services, energy, technology, telecoms and transportation. Our diverse and complementary services help clients enhance, fortify and defend their reputations, advance corporate strategy, manage regulatory risk and opportunities, and maintain productive, ongoing engagement with their most important stakeholders including federal- and state-level policy makers, investors, employees, customers, the media, and the general public. We do this in multiple jurisdictions and with our diverse and complementary capabilities.

Our business comprises of three reporting segments—Government Relations Consulting, Corporate Communications & Public Affairs Consulting and Compliance and Insights Services—corresponding to the different types of strategic communications services our member companies provide to our clients:

Government Relations Consulting services (which are also commonly referred to as "lobbying") include advocacy, strategic guidance, political intelligence and issue monitoring at the US federal and state levels and in the United Kingdom through our offices in London;

Corporate Communications & Public Affairs Consulting services include crisis communications, financial communications and investor relations, litigation support, community relations, social and digital media, public opinion research, branding and messaging, and relationship marketing, across the United States and internationally through our offices in London, Shanghai, Abu Dhabi, and Dubai; and
Compliance and Insights Services include lobbying compliance services and legislative tracking.

Importantly, as distinct from legacy branded competitors in our industry who have sought to be all-in-one providers of strategic communications services to their clients, we deliver complementary strategic communications services through stand-alone firms. Each of our firms is recognized for excellence in its respective area of expertise, and is incentivized to collaborate and to partner with each of our other firms while maintaining a strong focus on its specialized services. Our business model allows us to deliver both the scale and reach of those all-in-one providers and also the higher standards of quality, service, creativity, and nimbleness that traditionally have been the domain of smaller boutiques. We seek to eliminate for clients the traditional trade-off between scale and quality, and our growth demonstrates that our business model is well-suited to the needs and preferences of modern clients.

Since our inception in 2014, we have acquired and integrated numerous businesses specializing in key facets of the global strategic communications market. Under our holding company, we now operate as 12 member companies in the United States and the United Kingdom, with expanding reach into Europe and parts of Asia and the Middle East. Our 12 member companies (together with PPHC, the "Company") include Crossroads Strategies, LLC ("Crossroads"), Forbes Tate Partners LLC ("Forbes Tate"), Blue Engine Message & Media, LLC (doing business as Seven Letter) ("Seven Letter"), O'Neill & Partners, LLC (doing business as O'Neill & Associates) ("O'Neill"), Alpine Group Partners, LLC ("Alpine"), KP Public Affairs LLC ("KP"), MultiState Associates, LLC ("MultiState"), Concordant LLC ("Concordant"), Lucas Public Affairs, LLC ("Lucas"), Pagefield Communications Limited ("Pagefield"),TrailRunner International, LLC ("TrailRunner"), and Pine Cove Strategies, LLC ("Pine Cove").

We announced the earnings-accretive acquisition of Texas-based TrailRunner for initial consideration of $33.0 million plus potential earnout payments in January 2025. Closing occurred on April 1, 2025. TrailRunner is a Texas headquartered global strategic communications advisory firm that operates with a global team across offices in Texas, New York,

Nashville, and Northern California, London, Shanghai, Abu Dhabi, and Dubai. We announced the earnings-accretive acquisition of Pine Cove for initial consideration of $3.0 million in July 2025 plus potential earnout payments. Pine Cove is a strategic consulting firm that serves as a long-term partner to clients ranging from start-ups to established businesses and Fortune 100 companies. It advises and supports clients in navigating regulatory and complex business challenges.

We operate in large, growing markets. We estimate that our total addressable market ("TAM") in 2024 was in excess of $20.0 billion, comprising $4.4 billion of disclosed federal lobbying expenditure, an estimated $2.2 billion of partially disclosed total US state-based lobbying expenditure, an estimated $5.6 billion of global public affairs spend, and an estimated $8.4 billion global corporate communications spend. The latter, which covers corporate, crisis, and financial communications, became a larger part of our offering with the 2025 acquisition of TrailRunner.

As a company designed by and for the operators of advisory businesses, we optimize corporate strategy, cross-selling, and referral opportunities for our portfolio companies through proactive and collaborative engagement both firm-to-firm and at the holding company level. We provide our companies with a scalable platform for growth, providing uniform and efficient financial infrastructure, legal services, human resources, compliance and administration at the parent company level. We incentivize cross-company selling, talent referral and retention opportunities to sustain our world-class talent, and we reduce the overall incidence of client or sector conflicts by incentivizing our member companies to refer potential clients to other member companies or individual employees who are unconflicted and available to engage. These signature operator-friendly aspects of the business have enabled PPHC to successfully acquire firms that are among the very best in their fields, to retain and attract great talent in those firms, and to drive strong organic growth across the platform.

We have grown our geographical reach and practice capabilities to provide clients a full range of services through multiple member companies. Our evolution to date is the result of a careful and methodical strategy to build a unique service platform to simplify and more effectively address global client needs and opportunities in an increasingly fragmented and fast-moving environment where business, government, and public perception converge. This growth strategy is predicated on adding both geographic reach and a broad set of capabilities to help clients anticipate the expectations of key stakeholders and then drive stakeholder engagement and alignment.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
The success of our business depends on establishing and maintaining client relationships, in particular with our largest clients.
Our success depends on our ability to continue to develop and execute on our business strategy, in particular through future acquisitions and other strategic transactions.
We may fail to adequately monitor or manage the activities of our member companies, which retain a high degree of autonomy under our business model.

We may not be able to compete effectively in new geographies, business lines, and our recently acquired businesses outside the US expose us to regulatory and compliance regimes with which we are relatively unfamiliar.
We operate in a fragmented and highly competitive industry, and we could lose employees and clients to new or existing competitors or otherwise fail to compete successfully.
We may face competition from parties who sell their businesses to us, from professionals in acquired businesses who do not continue working for us post-acquisition or from our own former employees.
We are subject to macroeconomic and political risks that could negatively impact the demand for our services.
We rely on certain third parties and third-party technology to provide our services and successfully implement our business strategy.
Disruptions to our information technology systems or cybersecurity breaches could negatively impact our business.
Failure to comply with data privacy laws and regulations could adversely affect our business and reputation.

Servicing our debt requires a significant amount of cash, and our Bank Credit Facilities contain certain restrictive covenants, which could affect our ability to operate our business and implement our business plan.
We may not obtain insurance coverage to adequately cover all significant risk exposures.
Risks Related to Our Common Stock
We may not be able to maintain compliance with Nasdaq's listing standards, which could limit stockholders' ability to trade our Common Stock.
The market price and trading volume of our Common Stock may be volatile and may be affected by economic conditions beyond our control.
We will incur increased costs and our management will face increased demands as a result of operating as a company listed on Nasdaq and subject to Exchange Act reporting and other obligations.
If our operating and financial performance in any given period does not meet or exceed the guidance that we provide to the public, the market price of our Common Stock may decline.
paragraphs: An investment in the Company's Common Stock involves a high degree of risk. You should consider carefully all the risk factors described below, the matters discussed above under "Cautionary Notice Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and other information included and incorporated by reference in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, as well as in other reports and materials that we file with or furnish to the SEC. If any of the risks described below, or elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K or our other SEC filings, were to materialize, our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects could be materially adversely affected. In such case, the trading price of the Company's Common Stock could decline, and investors could lose part or all of their investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to the Company or that it currently deems immaterial may also materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects.

The success of our business depends on the ability of our individual member companies to establish and maintain strong client relationships. If we fail to build or maintain such relationships, it could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects. Although we have longstanding relationships with many of our clients, these clients usually do not enter into long-term contracts beyond 12 months, and a significant portion of our contracts with customers have termination clauses that give the customer the right to terminate the contract without cause with one month's notice without any substantial penalty. In addition, while the majority of our client work is retainer-based, approximately 10% of our revenue is typically generated from project-specific services provided to clients under separate contracts. The continued extension of our retainer-based consulting contracts and the continued uptake of project-specific service contracts depend on our ability to deliver top quality services to our clients and build client trust. In our complex and ever-evolving industry, there can be no assurance that we will be able to do so. Should any of our top clients by revenue terminate their relationship with us or significantly reduce their demand for our services, our revenue would be adversely affected. For the year ended December 31, 2025, fees attributed to our top ten clients (on a consolidated group basis) amounted to 9.2% of our revenue. While revenue from our top clients will vary from period-to-period, the revenue derived from a major client that permanently discontinued or significantly reduced its relationship with us could be difficult to replace, which could negatively impact our prospects.

Our ability to maintain and grow our business will depend on our reputation in the industry, which could be adversely impacted by negative publicity, our association with certain clients, our real or perceived failure to manage conflicts of interest or by adverse litigation or other factors.

We operate in an industry where integrity, client trust and confidence are paramount and, as a result, maintaining our professional reputation and managing potential conflicts of interest are critical to our business. Our brand and reputations could be negatively impacted by real or perceived conflicts of interest, litigation or claims against us, actual or alleged employee error or misconduct, operational failures, regulatory investigations, press speculation or negative publicity (whether or not based in truth), inadequate or negligent provision of services to clients or disclosure of confidential client information, among other factors. Our brand could also in the future be adversely affected by factors entirely beyond our control, such as the independent actions of our clients or negative media attention paid to our clients for any reason. The potential for negative brand and reputational exposure has increased with the global flow of information via the internet and social media, through which adverse comments, whether substantiated or not, can reach a wide audience very quickly and without appropriate balance or context. Due to the broad scope of our operations and our client base, we regularly address and have, in some instances, had to turn down certain opportunities due to actual and potential conflicts of interest.

We face risks of both (i) client conflicts, which are situations where our services to a particular client conflict, or are perceived to conflict, with the interests of another client, and (ii) own-interest conflicts, which are situations where our duty to act in the best interests of any client in relation to a matter conflicts, or there is a significant risk that it may conflict, with our own interests in relation to that or a related matter. Furthermore, where one or more of our member companies have access to material non-public information that may not be shared with our other member companies, it can also lead to an actual or perceived own-interest conflict. While we have extensive procedures and controls that are designed to identify and address conflicts of interest, including those designed to prevent the improper sharing of information among our member companies, appropriately identifying and dealing with conflicts of interest (both client conflicts and own-interest conflicts) is complex and difficult, and our reputation could be damaged and the willingness of clients to enter into engagements with us may be affected, if our procedures or controls fail or we otherwise fail, or appears to fail, to identify, disclose and deal appropriately with conflicts of interest. It is also possible that actual, potential or perceived conflicts could give rise to client dissatisfaction, litigation or regulatory enforcement actions, which could lead to significant reputational harm.

The success of our business depends on our reputation for providing high-quality professional services. If any of our member companies are involved in litigation or claims relating to its performance in a particular matter, the reputation of that individual company and the entire Company could be damaged. Our reputation could be damaged through any member company's disclosed involvement either as an advisor or as a litigant, in high profile or unpopular legal proceedings. We, on behalf of PPHC or any of our member companies, may be required to incur legal expenses in defending PPHC or the member companies against any litigation or claims and may also incur significant reputational and financial harm if such litigation or claims are successful or receive negative press coverage. Public Policy Holding Company, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "PPHC," or the "Company") through our wholly-owned subsidiaries, operates a portfolio of firms that offer global strategic communications services, including government relations, corporate communications and public affairs. Engaged by over 1,400 clients, including companies, trade

associations and non-governmental organizations, we are active in all major sectors of the economy, including healthcare and pharmaceuticals, financial services, energy, technology, telecoms and transportation. Our services help clients to enhance and defend their reputations, advance policy goals, manage regulatory risk and engage with federal and state-level policy makers, stakeholders, media and the public in multiple jurisdictions and with diverse and complementary capabilities.

Since our inception in 2014, we have acquired and integrated numerous businesses specializing in key facets of strategic communications, including government relations, public affairs, research, crisis management, investor relations and creative communications delivery. Under the PPHC holding company, we now operate as 12 member companies in the United States ("US" or "U.S.") and the United Kingdom ("UK"), with expanding reach into Europe and parts of Asia and the Middle East. These 12 member companies include Crossroads, Forbes Tate, Seven Letter, O'Neill, Alpine, KP, MultiState, Concordant, Lucas, Pagefield, TrailRunner, and Pine Cove.

We operate in large growing markets that we believe provide us significant opportunity for continued growth. We estimate our total addressable market ("TAM") in 2024 was in excess of $20.0 billion, comprising $4.4 billion of disclosed federal lobbying expenditure, an estimated $2.2 billion of partially disclosed total US state-based lobbying expenditure, an estimated $5.6 billion global public affairs spend, and an estimated $8.4 billion global corporate communications spend. The latter, which covers corporate, crisis, and financial communications, became part of our offering with the 2025 acquisition of TrailRunner. We believe this segment may be larger than $8.4 billion, though it is difficult to quantify given that industry metrics often combine it with broader public relations categories—such as marketing communications—that PPHC does not provide.

We have built a scalable platform which also creates cross-selling and referral opportunities. We provide our companies with a scalable platform for growth, providing uniform and efficient financial infrastructure, legal services, human resources, compliance and administration at the parent company level. We also incentivize cross-company selling, talent referrals and effective conflict management remedies across our client portfolio.

We have grown our geographical reach and practice capabilities to provide clients a full range of services through multiple member companies. Our evolution to date is the result of a careful and methodical strategy to build a unique service platform to simplify and more effectively address global client challenges and opportunities in an increasingly fragmented and accelerated policy and communications landscape. This growth strategy is predicated on adding both geographic reach for clients and a complete set of asset capabilities to bring the client the ability to synthesize and simplify the best in class practices to address policy and reputational issues. Leveraging deep policy and issue expertise derived from our original core government relations member companies, first established in 2014, we now work with clients to provide the full-spectrum of strategic communications, including government affairs, public affairs, issues and crisis communications, financial communications and corporate and institutional reputation management needs.

Building on the globalization of public policy and reputation challenges, our founders and many of our senior managers operate in Washington, DC, and have past careers and/or close professional ties to the US executive branch, Congress and regulatory authorities over a period of more than 30 years. Other leaders operate principally at the state or regional level, drawing on decades of experience, deep community ties and relationships with key stakeholders in key markets, including California, Texas and New York. With the acquisition of Pagefield in June 2024 and TrailRunner in April 2025, we have expanded our operations to London, Shanghai, Abu Dhabi and Dubai, giving us truly global reach. We continue to look for opportunities to broaden the geographic scope of our services both domestically and abroad.

Adding complementary practice capabilities to augment geographic coverage, our business comprises three reporting segments—Government Relations Consulting, Corporate Communications & Public Affairs Consulting and Compliance and Insights Services—corresponding to the different types of strategic communications services our member companies provide to our clients:

•Government Relations Consulting services include advocacy, strategic guidance, political intelligence and issue monitoring at the United States federal and state levels and internationally through our offices in London;

•Corporate Communications & Public Affairs Consulting services include crisis communications, community relations, social and digital media, public opinion research, branding and messaging, relationship marketing and litigation support; and
•Compliance and Insights Services include lobbying compliance services and legislative tracking.

As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 1,400 active client relationships, which were highly diversified with the top 10 PPHC clients representing 9.2% of revenue in 2025 versus 8.7% at the end of the year ended December 31, 2024. We have no single client representing more than 2.1% of overall revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025. Our client base includes corporate, trade association and non-profit client organizations across a range of industries. Our client portfolio includes clients in the healthcare and pharmaceuticals, defense and aerospace, agriculture, financial services, energy, technology, telecom and transportation sectors. We also have a track record of high client retention, with an average annual renewal rate of approximately 77.4% and an average revenue retention rate of 85.5% between 2020 to 2025.
From January 1, 2018 to December 31, 2025, we achieved revenue growth of 27.6% CAGR, with organic revenue growth of 15.0% CAGR over the same period.

paragraphs: 本公司之使命為成為全球戰略溝通的領導供應商，透過將來自世界各地的政府關係、企業溝通與公共事務專業人才結合，以實現客戶、員工與股東的共同成功。
本公司由在華盛頓特區公共政策與政府關係領域擁有數十年經驗的資深顧問創立，透過目標性收購與內生性成長，已擴大並多元化我們的全球溝通諮詢業務。我們設計此業務以應對大型企業與非營利機構在管理日益複雜且相互依存的公共政策與聲譽挑戰時所面臨的成長複雜性與成本，目前我們協助超過 1,400 家客戶在全球範圍內應對今日複雜的利害關係人網路，涵蓋企業事務的全範疇。本公司客戶包括《財富》百大企業中近半數。

在我們不斷成長的投資組閤中，我們的專業公司提供全球戰略溝通服務，包括政府關係、企業溝通、公共事務、研究、危機管理、財務溝通與投資者關係，以及創意溝通執行。我們在經濟各主要產業領域均有活動，包括醫療與製藥、資產管理與金融服務、能源、科技、電信與運輸。我們多元且互補的服務協助客戶提升、強化與保護其聲譽，推進企業戰略，管理法規風險與機會，並與其最重要的利害關係人維持建設性且持續的互動，包括聯邦與州級政策制定者、投資者、員工、客戶、媒體與大眾。我們在多個司法管轄區進行此項業務，並運用我們多元且互補的能力。
本公司業務包含三個應報告分部—政府關係諮詢、企業溝通與公共事務諮詢以及合規與洞察服務—對應我們成員公司為客戶提供的不同類型戰略溝通服務：
政府關係諮詢服務（也常被稱為「遊說」）包括在美國聯邦與州級以及英國透過倫敦辦公室所提供的倡議、戰略指導、政治情報與議題監測；
企業溝通與公共事務諮詢服務包括危機溝通、財務溝通與投資者關係、訴訟支援、社區關係、社會與數位媒體、公眾意見研究、品牌與訊息傳遞，以及關係行銷，遍及美國與國際市場，透過倫敦、上海、阿布扎比與杜拜辦公室；
合規與洞察服務包括遊說合規服務與立法追蹤。

重要的是，與我們產業中傳統以品牌為主的競爭對手不同，這些競爭對手試圖成為為客戶提供全方位戰略溝通服務的綜合服務商，我們則透過獨立公司提供互補的戰略溝通服務。我們每家公司均因其專業領域的卓越表現而受到認可，並被激勵與我們的其他公司合作，同時保持對其專業服務的強烈關注。我們的業務模式使我們能提供那些綜合服務商所具有的規模與影響力，同時也提供傳統上屬於小型精品事務所的高標準品質、服務、創意與靈活性。我們致力於消除客戶對規模與品質之間傳統取捨的考量，而我們的成長顯示出我們的業務模式符合現代客戶的需求與偏好。

自2014年成立以來，我們已取得並整合多家專門從事全球戰略溝通市場關鍵領域的企業。在本公司旗下，我們目前於美國與英國運作12家成員公司，並正在擴展至歐洲與亞洲及中東的部分地區。我們的12家成員公司（與PPHC共同組成「本公司」）包括Crossroads Strategies, LLC（「Crossroads」）、Forbes Tate Partners LLC（「Forbes Tate」）、Blue Engine Message & Media, LLC（營業名為Seven Letter）（「Seven Letter」）、O'Neill & Partners, LLC（營業名為O'Neill & Associates）（「O'Neill」）、Alpine Group Partners, LLC（「Alpine」）、KP Public Affairs LLC（「KP」）、MultiState Associates, LLC（「MultiState」）、Concordant LLC（「Concordant」）、Lucas Public Affairs, LLC（「Lucas」）、Pagefield Communications Limited（「Pagefield」）、TrailRunner International, LLC（「TrailRunner」），以及Pine Cove Strategies, LLC（「Pine Cove」）。
本公司宣佈進行獲利提升的收購行動，收購位於德州的 TrailRunner 公司，初始對價為 33.0 百萬美元，並可能於 2025 年 1 月支付 earnout 金額。交易於 2025 年 4 月 1 日完成。TrailRunner 是一家設立於德州的全球戰略通訊諮詢顧問公司，擁有全球團隊，辦公室位於德州與紐約。
我們宣佈以每股3.0 百萬美元的初始對價，加上潛在的 earnout 支付，於2025年7月取得Pine Cove。Pine Cove 是一家戰略諮詢公司，為從新創企業到已建立企業及財富100大企業的客戶提供長期合作夥伴服務。它協助並支持客戶應對法規及複雜業務挑戰。
我們經營於規模龐大且持續成長的市場。我們估計，我們在2024年的總可達市場（"TAM"）超過20.0 十億美元，包含4.4 十億美元的已揭露聯邦遊說支出，預估2.2 十億美元的部分揭露美國州級遊說支出，預估5.6 十億美元的全球公共事務支出，以及預估8.4 十億美元的全球企業溝通支出。後者，涵蓋企業、危機及財務溝通，隨著2025年收購TrailRunner，成為我們產品組閤中佔有較大比例的部分。

作為一家為顧問業務經營者設計並服務的公司，我們透過積極且協作的方式，於公司間及母公司層級，優化我們旗下公司的企業策略、交叉銷售與推薦機會。我們為旗下公司提供可擴展的成長平台，提供統一且高效的財務基礎設施、法律服務、人力資源、合規與行政服務。我們鼓勵跨公司銷售、人才推薦與保留機會，以維持我們的頂級人才，並減少客戶或產業衝突的發生，透過鼓勵旗下公司將潛在客戶推薦至其他旗下公司或個別員工，這些員工無衝突且可參與業務。這些獨特的經營者友好特質，使PPHC成功取得各領域中表現卓越的公司，並留住及吸引這些公司的優秀人才，同時推動平台內的強勁內生性成長。
我們已拓展地理範圍與專業能力，以提供客戶完整的服務範疇。我們至今的發展，是基於謹慎且系統化的策略，以建立獨特的服務平台，簡化並更有效地應對全球客戶需求與機會，應對日益碎片化且快速變動的環境，其中商業、政府與公眾觀感相互交織。此成長策略建立在增加地理範圍與廣泛能力的基礎上，以協助客戶預測關鍵利害關係人的期望，並推動利害關係人參與與對齊。

paragraphs: 以下為管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之分析（"MD&A"），總結影響本公司截至2025年12月31日及2024年財務狀況、營運成果與流動性，以及現金流之重大因素。此MD&A應與我們之合併財務報表、附註說明及本年度10-K申報表中包含之其他財務資訊一併閱讀。除歷史資訊外，此MD&A中討論之內容包含多種展望性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性，並基於對各種超出我們控制範疇之因素之判斷。我們實際之結果可能與這些展望性陳述所預期者有重大差異。所有展望性陳述僅為其發佈日之陳述。除非適用法律有要求，否則我們不負有更新此等陳述以反映發佈日後發生之事件或存在之情況之義務。本MD&A中包含之部分金額、百分比及其他數字已進行四捨五入調整。因此，某些表格或圖表中顯示為總計之數字，可能並非其前項數字之算術總和，且文中以百分比表示之數字可能總計不為100%，或在適當情況下，其總計可能並非其前項百分比之算術總和。

Public Policy Holding Company, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "PPHC," or the "Company") 透過我們之 wholly-owned subsidiaries，經營一個提供全球戰略溝通服務之投資組合，包括政府關係、企業溝通與公共事務。我們被超過1,400名客戶委託，包括公司、產業協會與非政府組織，我們在經濟中所有主要產業部門均有活動，包括醫療與藥品、金融服務、能源、科技、電信業者與運輸。我們的服務協助客戶提升與捍衛其聲譽，推進政策目標，管理法規風險，並與聯邦與州級政策制定者、利益相關者、媒體與公眾在多個司法管轄區進行互動，並具備多樣化且補充性的能力。

自我們2014年成立以來，我們已取得並整合多家專門從事戰略溝通關鍵領域之企業，包括政府關係、公共事務、研究、危機管理、投資者關係與創意溝通交付。在PPHC控股公司之下，我們現在美國（"US"或"U.S.")與英國（"UK"）運作12家成員公司，並正在擴展至歐洲與亞洲及中東部分地區。這些12家成員公司包括Crossroads、Forbes Tate、Seven Letter、O'Neill、Alpine、KP、MultiState、Concordant、Lucas、Pagefield、TrailRunner與Pine Cove。

我們運作於大型成長市場，我們認為這些市場為我們提供持續成長的顯著機會。我們估計2024年總可達市場（"TAM"）超過20.0百萬美元，包含4.4百萬美元之公開披露聯邦遊說支出，估計2.2百萬美元之部分公開總美國州級遊說支出，估計5.6百萬美元全球公共事務支出，以及估計8.4百萬美元全球企業溝通支出。後者，涵蓋企業、危機與財務溝通，於2025年收購TrailRunner後成為我們的服務項目。我們認為此部分可能高於8.4百萬美元，但因產業指標常將其與較廣泛的公共關係類別（如行銷溝通）結合，而PPHC並未提供，因此難以量化。

我們營運於規模龐大且快速成長的市場，我們認為這些市場為我們提供持續成長的重大機會。我們估計2024年我們的總可達市場（"TAM"）超過20.0 十億美元，包含4.4 十億美元的已揭露聯邦遊說支出，估計2.2 十億美元的部分揭露美國州級遊說支出，估計5.6 十億美元的全球公共事務支出，以及估計8.4 十億美元的全球企業溝通支出。後者包含企業、危機及財務溝通，於2025年收購TrailRunner後成為我們的服務項目。我們認為此分部的規模可能高於8.4 十億美元，不過因產業指標常將其與較廣泛的公共關係類別（如行銷溝通）合併，而PPHC並不提供這些服務，因此難以準確量化。

我們已擴展地理範圍與專業能力，以提供客戶完整的服務項目，透過多個成員公司。我們至今的發展是基於謹慎且系統化的策略，以建立獨特的服務平台，簡化並更有效地應對日益碎片化與加速的政策與溝通環境中之全球客戶挑戰與機會。此成長策略基於增加客戶之地理範圍與完整的資產能力，以讓客戶能整合並簡化最佳實務，以應對政策與聲譽問題。透過我們原始核心政府關係成員公司所衍生的深厚政策與議題專業知識，自2014年建立以來，我們現在與客戶合作，提供完整的戰略溝通服務，包括政府事務、公共事務、議題與危機溝通、財務溝通與企業與機構聲譽管理需求。

基於公共政策與聲譽挑戰的全球化，我們的創辦人與許多高階管理人員在華盛頓特區運作，並在過去30多年期間擁有與美國行政部門、國會與監管機構的過去職業與/或密切專業關係。其他領導者則主要在州或區域層級運作，依賴數十年的經驗、深厚的社區關係與關鍵市場（包括加州、德州與紐約）的關鍵利益相關者關係。透過2024年6月收購Pagefield與2025年4月收購TrailRunner，我們已擴展至倫敦、上海、阿布扎比與杜拜，具備真正的全球規模。我們持續尋找機會，以擴展我們服務的地理範圍，無論是在國內或國際。

基於公共政策全球化及聲譽挑戰，我公司的創辦人及許多高階管理人員於華盛頓特區運作，並在過去30年以上期間，擁有與美國行政部門、國會及監管機構的職業生涯與/或密切專業關係。其他領導者則主要於州或區域層級運作，憑藉數十年的經驗、深厚的社區關係，以及與關鍵市場（包括加州、德州與紐約）關鍵利益相關者的關係。透過2024年6月收購Pagefield及2025年4月收購TrailRunner，我們已將業務拓展至倫敦、上海、阿布達比與杜拜，實現真正全球化的業務版圖。我們持續尋找機會，以擴大我公司服務的地理範圍，無論是國內或國際。
增強地理覆蓋範圍的補充專業能力，本公司業務包含三個應報告分部—政府關係顧問服務、企業通訊與公共事務顧問服務以及合規與洞察服務—對應於我們成員公司為客戶提供的不同類型策略通訊服務：
•政府關係顧問服務包括在美國聯邦及州級以及國際層面的倡議、戰略指導、政治情報及議題監測，透過我們在倫敦的辦事處進行國際業務；
•企業通訊與公共事務顧問服務包括危機通訊、社區關係、社交與數位媒體、公眾意見研究、品牌與訊息傳達、關係行銷及訴訟支援；
•合規與洞察服務包括遊說合規服務及立法追蹤。

截至2025年12月31日，我們擁有約1,400個活躍客戶關係，這些客戶關係高度分散，2025年前十大PPHC客戶佔營業收入的9.2%，與2024年12月31日財務年度結束時的8.7%相比。我們沒有任何單一客戶佔全年營業收入超過2.1%。我們的客戶羣包括跨多個產業的企業、產業協會及非營利組織客戶。我們的客戶組合包括醫療與製藥、防禦與航太、農業、金融服務、能源、科技、電信及運輸產業的客戶。我們也擁有高客戶留存率的紀錄，2020年至2025年間，平均年度續約率約為77.4%，平均營收留存率為85.5%。
從2018年1月1日至2025年12月31日，我們實現了27.6%的年複合成長率（CAGR），在相同期間內，內生性營收成長率為15.0%的年複合成長率（CAGR）。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
我們業務之成功取決於建立並維持客戶關係，尤其是與我們最大客戶之關係。
我們之成功取決於我們持續發展並執行我們業務策略之能力，尤其是透過未來收購及其他戰略交易。
我們可能無法充分監測或管理我們成員公司之活動，這些公司在我們業務模式下保留高度自主權。
我們可能無法在新地理區域、業務線以及我們最近收購之業務中有效競爭，這些業務使我們面臨我們相對不熟悉的監管及合規制度。
我們經營於一個分散且高度競爭之產業，我們可能失去員工及客戶至新或現有競爭對手，或以其他方式無法成功競爭。
我們可能面臨來自將其業務出售給我們之當事人、來自收購業務中專業人士且未繼續為我們工作之員工，或來自我們前員工之競爭。
我們受總體經濟及政治風險影響，這些風險可能對我們服務之需求產生負面影響。
我們依賴某些第三方及第三方科技來提供服務並成功執行我們的業務策略。
資訊科技系統中斷或網路安全事件發生，可能會對我們的業務造成負面影響。
未能遵守資料隱私權法律及規範，可能會對我們的業務及聲譽造成不利影響。
償還我們的債務需要大量現金，且我們的銀行信貸融資協議包含某些限制性契約條款，這可能會影響我們運作業務及執行業務計畫的能力。
我們可能無法取得足夠覆蓋所有重大風險暴露的保險保障。
與我們普通股相關的風險
我們可能無法維持符合納斯達克上市標準，這可能會限制股東交易我們普通股的能力。
我們普通股的市場價格及交易量可能波動，且可能受我們無法控制的總體經濟條件影響。
本公司將面臨更高的成本，且管理階層將因作為納斯達克上市公司並需遵守證券交易法報表及其他義務而面臨更高的需求。
若本公司在任一特定期間的營運及財務表現未達或超越對外公佈的指引，則本公司普通股的市場價格可能下跌。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所列風險因素、上述「風險聲明」段落所討論的內容，以及本年度報告表10-K所包含及引用的資訊，以及其他我們向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交或提供之報告與資料。若下列所列風險或本年度報告表10-K或其他SEC文件中所提及之風險實現，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景造成重大不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能損失部分或全部投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉或認為重要，也可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景造成重大不利影響。

本公司業務的成功取決於各個成員公司能否建立並維持強大的客戶關係。若我們未能建立或維持這些關係，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景造成重大不利影響。雖然我們與許多客戶有長期的合作關係，但這些客戶通常不會簽訂超過12個月的長期契約，且我們與客戶簽訂的契約中，有相當大一部分包含終止條款，使客戶可在一個月內無需任何重大罰款即終止契約。此外，雖然我們大多數客戶工作為保留費模式，但約10%的營業收入通常來自於客戶在不同契約下訂購的專案服務。我們保留費模式諮詢契約的持續延長及專案服務契約的持續增加，取決於我們能否為客戶提供高品質的服務並建立客戶信任。在這個複雜且不斷進化的產業中，我們無法保證能成功做到這一點。若任何我們營收最高的客戶終止與我們的關係或大幅減少對我們服務的需求，將會對我們的營收造成不利影響。截至2025年12月31日，我們前十大客戶（以合併集團為基準）所產生的費用佔我們營收的9.2%。雖然我們前十大客戶的營收會因期別而異，但若某個主要客戶永久終止或大幅減少與我們的關係，其產生的營收可能難以取代，這可能會對我們的前景造成負面影響。
我們維持並擴大業務的能力將取決於我們在產業中的聲譽，而這可能會因負面宣傳、我們與某些客戶的關聯、我們實際或被認為未能管理利益衝突，或因不利的法律訴訟或其他因素而受到不利影響。

我們所處的產業中，誠信、客戶信任與信心至關重要，因此維護我們的專業聲譽並管理潛在的利益衝突是我們業務的關鍵。我們的品牌與聲譽可能因實際或被認為的利益衝突、法律訴訟或對我們的指控、實際或被指控的員工錯誤或不當行為、運營失敗、監管調查、媒體報導或負面宣傳（無論是否真實）、對客戶服務的不足或疏忽，或披露客戶機密資訊等因素而受到負面影響。我們的品牌也可能因完全超出我們控制範疇的因素而受到不利影響，例如客戶的獨立行動或因任何原因對我們客戶的負面媒體關注。隨著全球資訊透過互聯網與社交媒體的流動，負面評論（無論是否真實）可以迅速且無適當平衡或背景地傳播至廣泛觀眾，這使得負面品牌與聲譽風險增加。由於我們業務範圍廣泛且客戶羣眾眾多，我們經常處理並在某些情況下不得不拒絕某些機會，因實際或潛在的利益衝突。

我們面臨的風險包括（i）客戶衝突，即我們對某個客戶的服務與另一個客戶的利益衝突，或被認為與另一個客戶的利益衝突，以及（ii）自身利益衝突，即我們對任何客戶在某事上的義務與我們自身的利益衝突，或有重大風險可能衝突。此外，若我們的成員公司之一有權接觸到未公開的重要資訊，而未與其他成員公司共享，也可能導致實際或被認為的自身利益衝突。雖然我們有廣泛的程序與控制措施，旨在識別與處理利益衝突，包括防止成員公司之間不當資訊共享的措施，但識別與處理利益衝突（包括客戶衝突與自身利益衝突）是複雜且困難的，若我們的程序或控制措施失敗，或我們未能識別、披露並適當處理利益衝突，可能會損害我們的聲譽，並影響客戶與我們簽訂契約的意願。此外，實際、潛在或被認為的衝突可能導致客戶不滿、法律訴訟或監管執法行動，這可能導致重大聲譽損害。

本公司業務的成功取決於我們提供高品質專業服務的聲譽。若任何成員公司涉及與其在某項事務中的表現有關的法律訴訟或指控，該個別公司的聲譽以及整個本公司都可能受到損害。我們的聲譽可能因任何成員公司被披露參與高知名度或不受歡迎的法律程序，作為顧問或作為訴訟當事人而受到損害。我們可能代表PPHC或任何成員公司，需承擔防禦法律訴訟或指控的法律費用，並可能因該法律訴訟或指控成功或獲得負面媒體報導而遭受重大聲譽與財務損害。任何此類事件若
